tools.name: Blender
tools.version: 4.2 LTS with the UEFormat addon (io_scene_ueformat), run with --background --factory-startup
tools.role: body build: vanilla skeleton from Hun_Invs.uemodel plus the vanilla body's extra bones, joint placement by retarget mode, region re-pose, weights, Chaos cloth sections and cloth*.json, collision bodies, face morphs (CTRL_expressions_* + ARKit aliases, KarinFaceShow), FBX export (scripts/blender/)

tools.name: Unreal Engine
tools.version: 5.7 (Epic launcher build) with PythonScriptPlugin and EditorScriptingUtilities
tools.role: content project ProjectPBZ (ue/ProjectPBZ, empty HuaShira plugin): imports on the placeholder Hun_Skin_Skeleton, layered-material MIs (layer 0), VT textures, Chaos cloth, CopyPose blink anim blueprints (scripts/ue/ via tools/ue_run.ps1 / run_all.ps1); versioned cook (tools/cook.ps1) and UnrealPak IoStore container (tools/mkcontainer.ps1)

tools.name: PBZModTools editor plugin (ue/PBZModTools, C++)
tools.version: kit source; built with tools/build_plugin.ps1 (Visual Studio 2022 C++ build tools, project used MSVC 14.44)
tools.role: physics assets from JSON, morph curve metadata, layered material parameters by association / index, cloth from a material slot (masks, backstop, sim_slot shell, normals), cloth solver, section shadows, curve-only sequences, CopyPose overlay anim blueprint builder and editor self-test

tools.name: PbzExport (pbzexport/, C# on CUE4Parse)
tools.version: CUE4Parse / CUE4Parse-Conversion 1.2.2.202610 NuGet, net10.0 win-x64, built with the .NET 10 SDK
tools.role: list / json (blueprint bytecode with PBZX_SCRIPT=1) / export uemodel|gltf|psk / skel / raw / morphs over the game IoStore (AES from PBZX_AES, usmap, Oodle) and read-back of the mod container (PBZX_EXTRA)

tools.name: objscan (objscan/, C#) and Dumper-7 (patched, not bundled)
tools.version: net10.0 win-x64; Dumper-7 from its repository with the three patches in DEV_TOOLING.md
tools.role: locate the reordered GUObjectArray in the running game and dump the usmap

tools.name: usmap_fix.py
tools.role: drop the inherited property entries Dumper-7 writes into every struct (FField::Next read as PropertyLinkNext)

tools.name: release/install.ps1
tools.role: release package installer: Steam library lookup, buildid warning, hash checks, refuses while the game runs, removes the other Karin package
